subject: Private deployment license sizing & token-econ follow-up
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment license sizing & token-econ follow-up

Hi Alyssa — great talking earlier. Below is a concise recap + the asks I promised. I want to make sure we size the Private (VPC) proposal so it aligns with Nexa's unit economics and procurement window.

Recap (from today's demo & discovery)
- Workloads: customer-facing credit-decisioning + internal embeddings for search. Peak concurrent sessions expected during batch runs (nightly) and steady daytime inference for UI.
- Approx expected monthly generation: 2.5M prompts, avg 120 tokens generated per prompt (including system/user).
- Embeddings: 1.2M vectors/month (64-dim, stored in customer-managed index).
- Requirement: air-gapped VPC with customer KMS + audit logs for 13 months.

Open items I promised to follow up on
1) Confirm token volume and target unit $/1M tokens (you mentioned a target of ~$15k / 1M tokens across internal econ — can you confirm that is the right target or give a budget range?)
2) Environment count: you suggested "prod + stage + dev" initially. We should confirm whether you want a separate QA environment for compliance testing (that affects licensing and support SKU).
3) Support tier: Standard vs. Premium (24/7 SRE on-call, 4-hour response SLA on P0). Please indicate preferred level.
4) Procurement cadence & PO timeline — any constraints on contract term (12 vs 36 months) and billing cadence?

Attachments: I attached a quick environment sizing CSV (nexa-env-sizing.csv) and a draft Private pricing PDF (redwood-private-pricing-v1.pdf) with our standard licensing models. The CSV has the token math; let me know if you want the raw workbook.

Next steps
- Could you reply with: confirmed monthly token estimate (or range), final environment list (prod/stage/dev/qa), and preferred support tier? With that I can produce a firm quote and a sample commitment table with price per 1M tokens.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nexa.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment license sizing & token-econ follow-up

Thanks Marcus — quick answers inline.

Token estimates
- Generation: current pilot ~1.1M prompts/month; if production rolls out to two additional regions, we expect 4.5–5.5M prompts/month in Year 1. Based on your demonstration tokenization, assume 120 tokens per prompt avg -> that maps to roughly 540M–660M tokens/month (generation).
- Embeddings: 1.2M vectors/month is correct for us.

Budget and target unit economics
- We have an internal target for cloud inference spend of $8k–$12k per 1M generated tokens (this includes GPU amortized costs and SRE overhead). That target is aggressive; procurement will expect justification for line-item costs.

Environment list
- Confirming: prod, stage, dev. We can hold off on QA as a separate environment — we'll use stage for compliance validation.

Support tier
- We need Premium for the pilot-to-prod transition window (first 90 days), after which Standard is acceptable if we have clear runbooks and playbooks.

Procurement
- Nexa prefers 12–24 month terms initially. PO and legal review likely 6–8 weeks after receipt of an SOW + quote.

A couple of asks for your quote: please model both a 12-month and 24-month commitment, include list price and a committed-unit price (price per 1M tokens), and show delta if we opt for Premium support. Also call out any setup/one-time fees for private control plane & KMS integration.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
VP, Platform Engineering | Nexa Finance
alyssa.chen@nexa.com

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T17:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment license sizing & token-econ follow-up

Alyssa — thanks for the detailed numbers, that's super helpful. I built a simple commitment matrix and scenario table and attached an updated pricing draft (redwood-private-pricing-v1.pdf) and the CSV with the token math (nexa-env-sizing.csv). Summary highlights below.

Scenario summary (high level)
- Baseline (12-mo, 4.5M prompts/mo -> ~540M tokens/mo): List price $210k / month + $X per 1M tokens (see attachment). Committed price band (12-mo) we can offer: $9,000–$11,000 per 1M tokens depending on environment count and whether you take 24-mo term.
- Upside scenario (24-mo, 5.5M prompts/mo -> ~660M tokens/mo): better unit economics; committed price band: $7,500–$9,500 per 1M tokens.

Licensing model options we attached
- Option A: Per-environment subscription + per-1M-token metered overage. Environment SKU separate (prod/stage/dev). This gives predictable base fee for reserved capacity and isolation.
- Option B: Capacity-commit (tokens/month) pooled across environments + single private control plane fee. Simpler for procurement; better unit price if you commit to a high token floor.

Support pricing
- Standard (business hours): included in base. Premium (24/7 SRE + 4hr P0 SLA): +15–25% depending on term; the attachment shows the exact uplift rows.

Ask for you
- Confirm which licensing option you prefer (A vs B). If Option A, confirm env counts (prod=1, stage=1, dev=1). If Option B, confirm committed tokens/month target for pricing band.
- Confirm target per-1M token price you want us to use for the committed quote (you mentioned $8k–$12k). I prepared a sample quote at $9k / 1M as our mid-ask for a 12-month committed baseline.

I also flagged this to Marissa for pricing approval on discounts beyond the standard committed bands. Marissa — could you review the attached and advise if we have flexibility to go below $8k/1M on a 24-month term with a $X seat?

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachments: redwood-private-pricing-v1.pdf, nexa-env-sizing.csv

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment license sizing & token-econ follow-up

Marcus — quick internal note. I reviewed the numbers and the headroom on the standard 24-mo bands. We can approve the following flexibility for NX-4521 if procurement commits to 24 months and $600M tokens/month floor:

- Price floor: $7,250 / 1M tokens (includes 10% reduction for 24-mo term + 5% strategic partner discount).
- Setup fee: we can waive 50% of the Private control plane integration fee for the pilot if they sign before end of Q2.
- Support: Premium add-on at +18% (locked for the term).

Callouts: we should call out the audit-log retention (13 months) and KMS HSM integration as separate line items in the SOW; finance will want separate billing for those if they require a third-party appliance.

I'll let you surface the 24-mo priced option (with the $7,250 / 1M token floor) as a clear next-step quote to Alyssa + procurement. Keep me in loop when you send the redlined SOW.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
